recommendation: Keep the fix as-is. It completes the applied FHIR-34325 semantics in the authoritative Dosage datatype source without broadening into unrelated request-resource reason/asNeeded alignment work.
issue_request: FHIR-34325 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy issue for R5 asking Dosage to allow multiple PRN reasons by splitting asNeeded[x] into Dosage.asNeeded 0..1 boolean and Dosage.asNeededFor 0..* CodeableConcept, adding an invariant, and documenting that multiple asNeededFor conditions are interpreted as any condition being true.
initial_application: Commit 886f421a86f818e31e5eb518a478fcffae6c71db implemented most of the issue by splitting Dosage.asNeeded[x], adding 0..* Dosage.asNeededFor, adding the MedicationAsNeededReason example binding, updating medication examples, and adding the invariant. The remaining current-source gap was that the asNeededFor definition still described a single precondition and did not state the approved any-condition semantics for multiple repetitions.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini shows Dosage is an active normative datatype owned by Pharmacy and routed to the dosage pages, so source/datatypes/dosage.xml is build-scoped source. The originating Zulip thread for the Jira explicitly raised the ambiguity of whether multiple PRN reasons mean at least one criterion or all criteria. Later FHIR-41267 fixed asNeeded/asNeededFor comment placement and is already represented on the combined branch; it did not address the missing multiple-reason semantics. FHIR-40765 was a later no-change background discussion about request-resource reason/asNeeded alignment and did not supersede this Dosage-specific rule.
reconciliation: Updated source/datatypes/dosage.xml so the Dosage.asNeededFor definition says the medication is taken based on one or more preconditions and, when multiple asNeededFor values are present, may be taken if any identified condition is true.
source_changes: source/datatypes/dosage.xml: changed the Dosage.asNeededFor definition from a single-precondition description to one-or-more preconditions with explicit any-condition semantics for multiple repetitions.

related_jiras.note: Later applied Pharmacy clarification for Dosage.asNeeded/asNeededFor comment placement; already represented on the combined branch by a567a0d64d8c48762b04288128f4040061424430 and preserved by this fix.
Later no-change issue discussed broader request-resource reason/asNeeded alignment and confirmed Dosage.asNeeded/asNeededFor are distinct from MedicationRequest.reason.
